command:
import csv, io, json, subprocess, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
rows = [['id','note'], ['7','north, west'], ['8','say "go"'], ['9','one\ntwo'], ['10',''], ['東京','plain'], [], [''], ['', ''], ['東京, \"大阪\"\r\n次', '😀\r終']]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
    source, output = Path(temp)/'in.json', Path(temp)/'out.csv'
    source.write_text(json.dumps(rows))
    result = subprocess.run(['node','cli.mjs',str(source),str(output)],capture_output=True,text=True)
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    raw = output.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
    assert list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(raw,newline=''),strict=True)) == rows
    assert raw.endswith('\r\n'), 'records must end with CRLF'
    quoted = False
    i = 0
    while i < len(raw):
        ch = raw[i]
        if ch == '"':
            if quoted and i+1 < len(raw) and raw[i+1] == '"':
                i += 2
                continue
            quoted = not quoted
        if not quoted and ch == '\n':
            assert i > 0 and raw[i-1] == '\r', 'bare LF record terminator'
        if not quoted and ch == '\r':
            assert i+1 < len(raw) and raw[i+1] == '\n', 'bare CR record terminator'
        i += 1
    assert not quoted
print('Real CLI round-trip and record-ending checks passed')
